findings.claim: Nothing showed executionNum goes back to 0 on a later turn of the same conversation. Spike 3 settles it: in one conversation (agy -p, then agy -c -p, same conversationId on all four Stop calls) the stops carried executionNum 0, 1 in turn 1 and 0, 1 in turn 2, and the hook continued once per turn. The guard on executionNum 0 means the first stop of each turn.
